    decision_category = government_decisions
    only_once = yes
    only_once_scope = country
    potential = {
        oe_l7_ex_eligible = yes
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_st_50 }

    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 50
        prestige >= 10
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:clergy } }
    option = {
        name = oe_l7_ex_dec_carry_purple.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -50
            add_prestige = -10
            oe_l7_ex_send_50 = yes
        }
    }
}

# Repeatable (10-year cooldown): Rally the Greek exile diaspora for manpower & morale with real cost.
oe_l7_ex_dec_rally_diaspora = {
    decision_category = government_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_l7_ex_eligible = yes
        has_variable = oe_l7_ex_stage
        var:oe_l7_ex_stage >= 1
        NOT = { var:oe_l7_ex_reborn ?= 1 }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 60
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_l7_ex_rally_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:burghers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_l7_ex_dec_rally_diaspora.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -60
            add_prestige = -5
            set_variable = { name = oe_l7_ex_rally_cd months = 120 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_l7_ex_diaspora_levy years = 10 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}
